record.paper_title: Open Problems on Syzygies and Hilbert Functions
record.original_question: If a homogeneous ideal I in S contains a regular sequence of n quadratic forms, does there exist a monomial ideal containing x1^2,...,xn^2 with the same Hilbert function as I?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $k$ be a field and $S = k[x_1, \dots, x_n]$ the standard graded polynomial ring. For a homogeneous ideal $J \subseteq S$, its Hilbert function is $H_J(d) = \dim_k (S/J)_d$. A sequence $f_1, \dots, f_n \in S$ of homogeneous forms is called a regular sequence if, for each $i$, the image of $f_i$ in $S/(f_1, \dots, f_{i-1})$ is a nonzerodivisor.

Suppose $I \subseteq S$ is a homogeneous ideal that contains a regular sequence consisting of $n$ quadratic forms. Does there necessarily exist a monomial ideal $M \subseteq S$ such that $x_1^2, x_2^2, \dots, x_n^2 \in M$ and $H_M(d) = H_I(d)$ for every $d \geq 0$?
artifact.status_search_result: This is the quadratic (all degrees equal to 2) instance of the Eisenbud–Green–Harris conjecture. It remains open in general, but several partial results are known: the case n ≤ 4 was settled earlier, the case n = 5 was proved by Güntürkün and Hochster, and Caviglia–De Stefani proved cases of EGH for fast-growing degree sequences. Specialized cases (monomial regular sequences, ideals with extra structure) are also known to hold.

status_evidence.title: On the Eisenbud-Green-Harris Conjecture
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses partial results on the EGH conjecture for regular sequences of quadrics and other cases.
status_evidence.claim: The EGH conjecture, of which the quadratic case is a special instance, is open in general with partial results.

status_evidence.title: The Eisenbud-Green-Harris conjecture for fast-growing degree sequences
status_evidence.snippet: Proves the EGH conjecture under fast-growing degree assumptions.
status_evidence.claim: Recent partial progress on EGH; full conjecture, including all-quadratic case for arbitrary n, is not resolved.

status_evidence.title: Hilbert functions of monomial ideals containing a regular sequence
status_evidence.snippet: Studies when ideals containing a regular sequence have the same Hilbert function as a monomial ideal containing powers of the variables.
status_evidence.claim: Directly addresses the question for monomial ideals; the general statement remains conjectural.
